title: How can we gamify a Discord server?
author: TheUniverseOrNothing
selftext:
I started building a prototype yesterday, and I’m curious what others think.

The idea is to turn a Discord community for game devs and AI builders into an explorable game world. Right now links are getting lost in the wall of text.

So you can claim your own room to showcase your projects, with links and playable previews.

There is a large community showcase screen that highlights projects from the most active and popular members.

Discord integration lets you @ a bot with updates or new links, and it automatically updates your room in-game.

You can explore and give feedback. Walk from room to room, check out what people are building, and earn credits for engaging with their projects. Those credits could unlock perks like better room placement or a spot on the main showcase screen.

Guests can explore the world freely, but joining the Discord lets you claim a room and become part of the community.

I don’t want this to just be another place to dump project links. I want to make it fun to explore, give people a reason to participate, and help cool projects get discovered.

How would you gamify something like this? What features or mechanics would make you actually want to come back and participate?

I’m still in the early stages, so I’m open to ideas and collaboration!
